rows.comment: Legal responsibility clause. It is direct and states a legal position, so it stays unchanged.
lineComments: States who is responsible for app and hardware use.
Extends responsibility to decisions made from app output.
Completes the clause; legal wording, leave as is.

rows.comment: Risk-assumption clause and safety warning. Plain and necessary.
lineComments: Names the inherent risk of physical activity.
Assigns that risk to the user; legal statement, keep.

rows.comment: Tells the user what they must safeguard, with a concrete example (AI Coach). Fine.
lineComments: Lists the credentials the user must protect.
Covers user-supplied configuration.
The AI Coach example is concrete and accurate.

rows.comment: Title case heading; the style rule asks for sentence case.
lineComments: Heading in title case; change to sentence case.

rows.comment: Em dash and an ambiguous "It". The privacy statements (on by default, can be turned off, no health data) are kept as written.
rows.replacement:
The App uses Firebase (Google) for anonymous crash/error and performance
      monitoring (Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring, Analytics). This is on by
      default and you can turn it off at any time in Settings. See the Privacy
      Policy for details. This monitoring never includes your health data.
lineComments: Names the vendor and the three services; keep.
Default-on statement is a privacy fact; keep it as is.
Replace the em dash with a period.
"It" is unclear; name the monitoring as the subject.

rows.comment: "Certain other" is filler. Say what the section does.
rows.replacement:
Other optional features use third-party services that you configure or consent to
      separately, including:
lineComments: Drop "Certain" and use the active verb "use".
Keep "including" so the list stays non-exhaustive.

rows.comment: States the data flow, the default provider and the user-supplied key. Specific and accurate.
lineComments: Says the user chooses what is shared.
Names the default provider, OpenAI.
Notes the user supplies the API key.

rows.comment: Names the two health platforms. Nothing to cut.
lineComments: Describes the optional integration.
Names Apple Health and Google Health Connect.

rows.comment: Opt-in statement and disclaimer of responsibility for third parties. Legal and privacy content, leave unchanged.
lineComments: Off-by-default and explicit-action statement; keep.
Disclaimer of responsibility for third-party practices.
Completes the disclaimer; keep.

lineComments: Heading in title case; change to sentence case.

rows.comment: Standard capitalised warranty disclaimer. Legal text; do not weaken or reword.
lineComments: As-is disclaimer.

Continues the list; legal wording.
Disclaims error-free and uninterrupted operation.
Disclaims metric accuracy; legal statement, keep.

Scopes liability to use of the App.
Repeats the extent-of-law qualifier; legal wording, keep.

for the full terms on use, modification, and redistribution of the code.
      These Terms govern your use of the App. The MIT License governs the source
      code.
lineComments: Trim "governing" and the repeated "itself".
Say which document covers the App.
Say which document covers the code, once.
